text_block_list.text:
This happened on the way back from a 
shopping trip to the commercial district 
with Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Trainer, down this street.
choice_data_list: Why? Wouldn't that be a detour...?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Here is the raffle venue. You received a 
raffle ticket earlier, right?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
From the grand prize down to the 
participation prize, they're all 
practical, so you've got nothing to lose.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Today's shopping trip isn't over until we 
draw the lottery. Here, go right ahead.
choice_data_list:
Did you know there's a raffle going on, by 
any chance?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. This is part of the 
preliminary research to ensure a 
productive shopping trip.

She must have accounted for getting a 
lottery ticket with this shopping trip. 
Just what I'd expect from a great 
supporter like Ikuno Dictus.
choice_data_list: Then shall we pull together?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. A raffle as joint 
effort—that feels just like us.

Together with Ikuno Dictus, I boldly 
turned the handle of the lottery wheel!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: The grand prize...!
choice_data_list: That's incredible!
Isn't that amazing!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm happy too... No, that's not 
right. At times like this, one should—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaay!! Grand prize hot springs trip, 
here I comeeee!!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Then, this travel voucher is for you, 
Trainer. Please go relax and take a 
well-deserved rest at the hot springs.
choice_data_list:
You're the one who won it, so you should 
be the one to use it, Ikuno.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I believe this is something you need more 
than I do, Trainer. My condition is 
managed by "IRON WILL", but as for you, 
Trainer...

Ikuno Dictus narrows her eyes. It feels 
like she can see right through all the 
fatigue in my body. Even so, I can't just 
accept a travel voucher—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Even if I say that, you will probably 
hesitate to accept. However, I am truly 
worried about you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Pressing between her eyebrows while 
looking at a tablet. A slightly hunched 
posture. Her shoulders are constantly 
rolled forward.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I must take measures before you collapse, 
Trainer. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
How about a hot spring trip for just the 
two of us? That way, you wouldn't have to 
feel self-conscious, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, if that's the case...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's decided, then. Let us both take this 
opportunity for some bodily maintenance.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Once this year's races are over and things 
settle down, let's take a trip to a hot 
spring.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Let us add it to the task list so we do 
not forget."

Just like she did, I also added "Hot 
Springs Trip" to my smartphone's task 
list.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Please don't forget, okay?
choice_data_list: I won't forget!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, even if you forget, I'll come and 
remind you.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
This carrot hamburg steak is famous for 
its delicious secret sauce.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Since we have them, would you care to have 
them for dinner tonight?
choice_data_list: Sounds good, let's do that!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"The aroma of this sauce... Is it spices? 
It really whets the appetite."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Well then......
choice_data_list: What's wrong?

text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus sits motionless with her fork 
and knife at the ready. She stares at the 
carrot hamburger steak with a troubled 
expression.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, I am not very good at eating 
hamburgers. ...However, this is a 
Salisbury steak. There shouldn't be any 
issue, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...A sense of déjà vu, perhaps? A rather 
bitter memory just crossed my mind..."
choice_data_list: If you're worried, I'll taste it first.
If you're worried, I'll taste it first.

text_block_list.text:
With those words, she cut into the carrot 
hamburg steak.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: !! I remember now! Trainer, wait—
(Sway... Splat!)

The carrot sticking out of the hamburg 
steak topples over. At that moment, sauce 
splattered everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. Carrot Hamburgers hold this 
very trap..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If only I had remembered a little 
sooner...
choice_data_list: No, it was my carelessness
No, it was my own carelessness.

text_block_list.text:
If you don't pull the carrot out of the 
Carrot Hamburger Steak first, it usually 
topples over and makes a disaster. Even 
though I knew that from experience.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The carrots on a Carrot Hamburger Steak 
are often quite unstable.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To avoid repeating the hamburger incident, 
I researched how to eat it properly. 
However, the probability of sauce 
splattering remains exceptionally high.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Even if you knock over the carrots first, 
they can still make a big splash as they 
fall, you know...
choice_data_list: I know!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, one can never let their guard down 
around hamburg steak either...

Even after that, the two of us enjoyed 
eating the Hamburg steaks while trying to 
figure out the best way to eat them.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A heaping mountain of carrots... 
Naturally, I have taken every precaution.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "A full-course carrot meal"!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"This is Katsuragi Ace-san, our cooking 
instructor for today."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm Katsuragi Ace, but Ace-sensei works 
fine. Nice to meetcha!
choice_data_list: Teacher Ace, we're in your hands...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha ha! So serious! That's Ikuno's 
Trainer for you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I foresaw something like this happening, 
so I asked Ace-san in advance."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To finish eating the carrots while they're 
still fresh, a "Full Carrot Course" comes 
highly recommended.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
On my family's farm, we often end up 
eating a ton of irregular veggies that 
can't be sold on the market.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"So I know plenty of carrot recipes! Well, 
home cooking recipes, anyway."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I asked for the dish names in advance... 
but there were so many menu items, and 
such a huge variety. It was simply too 
much for me to master on my own.
choice_data_list:
So, I got Ace to promise she'd be our 
instructor.

So, did you get Ace to promise to be the 
lecturer?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yep. You never know what you'll win in a 
raffle, so she's being way too prepared!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Well, since you went out of your way to 
ask me. I'd be glad to lend a hand!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Next, put the salted carrots into the 
bowl... Ace, how much seasoning should I 
use?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Measurements? Dump in a bunch of sugar, 
splash in some vinegar, and add just a 
pinch of salt.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me, could you please give the 
measurements in milliliters or tablespoons 
and teaspoons?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I don't measure every single thing! You 
just gotta go with the feeling, right!
choice_data_list:
Let's try doing it Ace-sensei's way this 
time!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
True, that's also a learning experience. 
Now then... let's start with the sugar.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Pour it in... about this much?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Hey now, if you put 'em in piece by piece 
like that, the sun's gonna go down!"
choice_data_list:
Then is this about the right amount of 
vinegar?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That's way too much, too much! Ah 
geez, gotta add more sugar to balance it 
out.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Um... this looks more like a soup than 
namasu, though...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it'd be a waste to throw out these 
seasonings. Alright, let's just chuck in 
some other veggies too!

And so, the three of them had fun cooking 
together, filling their bellies with a 
finished "Carrot Full Course"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, entirely within expectations. Shall 
we, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh? If it isn't Ikuno and Trainer. What a 
coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san, and Turbo-san too. ...Are 
those carrots in that bag from the raffle, 
by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I won 3rd prize, a bunch of carrots! 
Jealous, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Actually, we won third prize and got 
carrots too. It seems we were thinking the 
exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'll go order for Ikuno too!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes, please.
choice_data_list: An order...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hellooo! Two extra-large, soft-and-light 
Hachimies and a grater! Pleaaaseeee!!
choice_data_list: A grater!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so you didn't know about it, 
Trainer-san. It's a secret menu item at 
the Hachimi drink shop.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
When the lottery season rolls around, many 
Umamusume want to eat the prize carrots 
right away. So the shops make special 
accommodations for them.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Grater is on standby! Grind awayyy! 
*shwoooosh*!!

And so, I thoroughly enjoyed the Hachimi 
Drink with grated carrots that Twin Turbo 
had made.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, these coarsely grated carrots have 
the best texture, Turbo-san.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ehehehe, darn right!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo, why's everyone gathered around? 
Ah, you're drinking Hachimii.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It has the carrots I won from the 
lottery in it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ho-ho, 3rd prize, huh? Actually, me too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Though Carrot Hachimi sounds pretty good 
too~

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: If you'd like, shall we trade halves?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, by all means.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo too, Turbo too! Let's swap halves!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's do that~.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Tannhauser-san, wouldn't that make your 
entire portion honey drink? After all, one 
half plus one half equals one.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wha-aat?! O-On second thought, make it a 
quarter each~~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Good grief, O-Machi really is an airhead~!

Lively laughter echoed beneath the 
carrot-orange sky. It was a sweet, 
refreshing moment, just like a nice drink.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ............ I am terribly sorry...
choice_data_list: Ah, there's no need to apologize!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No... I considered various useful 
applications for tissues, but... I 
couldn't find anything more effective than 
sanitary purposes.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Pathetic... My investigative skills were 
sorely lacking.
choice_data_list: Wouldn't sanitary use be enough...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now that it has come to this, I intend to 
carry these tissues with me and seek out a 
more meaningful way to use them.

Ikuno Dictus slumped her shoulders, having 
demonstrated her bizarre obsessiveness...
